parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs with max_phase = 4 that have a mechanism of action classified as 'BLOCKER'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno, and join drug_mechanism to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target chembl_id, and target name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, and target_name.
